title: Limiting eigen-structure of spiked sample covariance matrices under missing observations
summary: High-dimensional Principal Component Analysis (PCA) has become an essential tool in modern data analysis, offering dimensionality reduction and feature extraction. However, the presence of missing data introduces significant challenges, distorting the performance of PCA and complicating statistical inference. In this paper, we study the asymptotic behavior of PCA under a spiked population model with missing observations, leveraging recent advances in random matrix theory.
